newsitem.title: USA: Grant Geophysical sees lower Q3 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Grant Geophysical sees lower Q3 earnings.

text.p: Grant Geophysical Inc said on Wednesday it expected to report substantially reduced earnings in the third quarter due to liquidity constraints and reduced margins on some field crews.
The geophysical services company also said it would begin an aggressive restructuring of operations at all levels, and would therefore take a charge in the fourth quarter.
The company, which reported a second quarter loss of $0.15 per share on August 15, was not immediately available to comment further.
There was no First Call mean earnings estimate for the third quarter ending September, but the mean estimate for the full fiscal year was a profit of $0.15 per share.
The company said it was restructuring at all levels to improve contract margins, reduce administrative and overhead costs and strengthen the company's financial position.
